movelist.name: Twister
movelist.effect: Small or Medium targets in the central square of the blast are not hit. Twister Flinches the target on 18-20 during Accuracy Check. Any Pokémon Airborne as a result of Fly or Sky Drop above the Blast are hit, ignoring range, and Twister has a Damage Base of 8 against those targets instead.

movelist.name: Scary Face
movelist.effect: The target’s Speed is lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Ancient Power
movelist.effect: On 19+, the user has each of its stats raised by +1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Crunch
movelist.effect: Crunch lowers the target’s Defense 1 Combat Stage on 17+

abilities.name: Air Lock
abilities.effect: The weather is set to normal as long as the Pokémon with Air Lock wants it to remain that way. The user may continue to sustain this effect as a Swift Action each round.

abilities.name: Run Away
abilities.effect: The user does not provoke Attacks of Opportunity by Shifting.  The user cannot be Trapped.
